steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each objective needs a measure, a target, an owner and a method that can measure the target.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 objective cannot be measured as written

findings.title: Target cannot be measured with the stated method
findings.fix: Change the method or the target

outcome.notChecked: Whether the objectives are the right ones for the business.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] obj-scrap.md:12  Target cannot be measured with the stated method.
       Fix: Change the method or the target.
[medium] obj-supplier.md:19  Objective with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] obj-on-time.md:26  Objective with no measure.
       Fix: Add a measure.
Not checked: Whether the objectives are the right ones for the business.
pros: Checks an objective with a missing item and an objective whose target cannot be measured with the stated method.
cons: Not checked: Whether the objectives are the right ones for the business.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-quality-objectives skill on the records for this review.
